description: Next-set focus golden cases run by Android NextSetFocusTest and iOS NextSetFocusTests. After the user records one set in the active workout, the screen moves its current-set focus (and scrolls it into view when needed) to the next incomplete set. sets lists every set of the workout AFTER the record as [exerciseIndex, setIndex, completed]; recorded is [exerciseIndex, setIndex] of the set that was just recorded (it is always completed in sets and never its own target). next is the target [exerciseIndex, setIndex], or null when nothing is left to do (workout complete: no focus change). Order: the first incomplete set after the recorded one in workout order (rest of the same exercise, then the following exercises); when none is left, wrap to the first incomplete set before it (earlier sets of the same exercise first, then earlier exercises); else null. Exercises whose sets are all complete have no incomplete set, so they are skipped automatically. Input order does not matter: sets are ordered by exerciseIndex then setIndex.
